scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('projects', 'dist/projects', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('projects/studio')) fs.cpSync('projects/studio', 'dist/studio', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', 'dist', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); console.log('Build OK: all projects, studio and assets copied to dist');"
